# Planted link errors

A [missing page](../spec/pages/missing.md).

An [unregistered fragment](../spec/pages/warm-pools.md#no-such-anchor).

A [heading anchor by attribute](../spec/pages/warm-pools.md#overview).

A [heading anchor by slug](../spec/pages/warm-pools.md#model).

A [fragment into a placeholder](../spec/pages/derived.md#derived-r1).

A [fragment registered on another page](../spec/pages/warm-pools.md#claim-r1).

A [link into a numbered file](../spec/04_system-components.md#anything-goes), which this pass does not check.

A [valid link](../spec/pages/pod-claims.md#claim-r1) and a [valid page link](../spec/pages/derived.md).
